comments.text: Indonesia is fascinating because being one country does not mean having one way of life. 🇮🇩🌋 More than 17,000 islands create enormous differences in language, food, religion, architecture and local traditions. The Bajau sea nomads are especially interesting because their entire culture developed around mobility and a relationship with the ocean that most modern societies have almost completely lost.
